label: Conflict: Clashes between Bangladesh Nationalist Party supporters and banned Awami League activists in Bera Upazila, Pabna District, injure several people following an arson attack at the abandoned home of former Deputy Speaker Shamsul Hoque Tuku and retaliatory vandalism, with police firing rubber bullets and tear gas to disperse the crowd.

label: Business: At least 80 garment factories in Savar and Ashulia, Bangladesh, declare general holidays after workers stage sit-ins and work stoppages over minimum wage demands, while police announce that 96 people, including five labour leaders, have been arrested in connection with the 4 November clashes on the Dhaka–Aricha Highway.
